result.rationale: The migration directly interpolates the freeform setting value into SQL: `INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, category_id, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`. A host string containing a single quote (the setting was previously freeform text) would break the INSERT statement and abort the migration.

adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb, the migration builds raw SQL with string interpolation: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)"`. Since `h` comes from the existing `site_settings` value (`val.split("\n")`), any host entry containing a single quote will produce invalid SQL (or worse) and can abort the migration. The diff shows no escaping/quoting helper (e.g., `quote`, `sanitize_sql_array`, prepared statements).
